item.text: {"analysis":"Trial crashed with subprocess exit status 1 after consuming 77.72 allocated GPU-seconds. The supplied traceback contains only the host's subprocess failure; it does not reveal the underlying training exception or failure stage. No validation score was reported. The code attempts to persist the full exception in working/training_error.txt, but that file's contents were not provided, so the cause remains unknown.","code_summary":"One independently trained SASRec model per category, with 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.3, and maximum sequence length 100. A jointly trained gated projection of the last five valid item embeddings augments each Transformer representation. Training uses sampled-softmax cross-entropy with 2,048 shared negatives, AdamW, seed 42, and validation-based selection of one checkpoint per category. The generated predictor restores the matching architecture and routes each dataset to its single selected checkpoint; no ensemble or checkpoint averaging is used."}
